zh.title: FlyersRights 起訴美國運輸部 擬改報延誤分類轉嫁旅客成本
zh.summary: FlyersRights 向哥倫比亞特區巡迴法院提起訴訟；DOT 新規將十類延誤移出航空公司責任
body: 乘客權益團體 FlyersRights 於 2026 年 10 月 30 日宣佈，已向美國哥倫比亞特區巡迴法院提交請願，指控運輸部（DOT）超越國會授權、且未經公眾意見徵詢即通過新規。
運輸部於 2026 年 9 月 3 日發布該規則，原定生效日後因美國航空業協會（Airlines for America）請求而推遲至 2027 年 2 月 1 日；修訂後的報告要求將自 2027 年 1 月 1 日起適用。
新規將十類幹擾——包括特定非計畫維修與網路攻擊——從「航空公司」責任類別移出，意即航空公司無需對這些原因負擔餐飲、住宿等協助義務。
FlyersRights 指出，國會僅要求修改航空公司延誤原因報告方式，並未授權降低對滯留旅客的照顧責任；並批評 DOT 跳過常規的公開意見徵詢程序。
DOT 在規則中承認，預期航空公司在這十類原因被排除後，將減少提供餐飲、住宿及交通等協助。

en.title: FlyersRights sues US DOT over rule shifting flight delay costs to passengers
en.summary: FlyersRights files petition; DOT rule reclassifies ten delay causes, reducing airline obligations
body: Passenger‑rights group FlyersRights announced on 30 October 2026 that it filed a petition in the US Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit, alleging the Department of Transportation (DOT) exceeded Congressional authority and adopted the rule without public comment.

The DOT published the rule on 3 September 2026 but postponed its effective date to 1 February 2027 after a request from Airlines for America; the revised reporting requirements will apply to flights beginning 1 January 2027.
The rule moves ten disruption types — including certain unscheduled maintenance and cybersecurity attacks — out of the “Air Carrier” category used for problems deemed within an airline’s control.

FlyersRights argues Congress only directed DOT to change how airlines report delay causes, not to lessen their duty to assist stranded passengers, and criticizes the agency for skipping the normal notice‑and‑comment process.
The DOT acknowledged in the rule that it expects airlines to provide less in amenities and compensation once the ten causes are excluded from the airline‑controlled category.

zh.title: 俄勒岡州麥克明維爾機場(MMV)直升機相撞事故 三死
zh.summary: 俄勒岡州MMV機場直升機相撞；三人死亡；NTSB調查中今日
body: 當地時間10月29日下午約2時10分，俄勒岡州麥克明維爾機場(MMV)東南側約一英里處發生直升機空中相撞，導致三人死亡。
根據亞姆希爾縣治安官辦公室確認，現場發現羅賓遜R22上有兩名乘員，空中巴士AS350B3上有一名乘員，三人均已喪生。
羅賓遜R22屬於傑瑞·崔布爾直升機公司，正執行教學飛行，機上為22歲德州飛行教官與31歲英國學員；空中巴士AS350B3則由精密公司資深飛行員獨自執行維修後檢查飛行。
國家運輸安全委員會(NTSB)已介入調查，預計約30天內發布初步報告；該機場無管制塔，飛行員依共用無線電頻率通報位置。
事發時目擊者稱兩架直升機在距地面約500英尺高度相撞，NTSB航空安全調查員葛蘭特·米爾斯於10月30日簡報中說明上述細節。

en.title: Three killed in midair helicopter collision at McMinnville Municipal Airport (MMV), Oregon
en.summary: Three dead in midair helicopter collision at McMinnville (MMV), Oregon; NTSB investigating
body: At about 2:10 p.m. local time on October 29, 2026, a midair collision occurred roughly one mile east of McMinnville Municipal Airport (MMV) in Oregon, killing three people.
The Yamhill County Sheriff’s Office confirmed that the Robinson R22 carried two occupants and the Airbus AS350B3 carried one; all three were pronounced dead at the scene.

The Robinson R22, owned by Jerry Trimble Helicopters, was on an instructional flight with a 22‑year‑old flight instructor from Texas and a 31‑year‑old student pilot from the United Kingdom. The Airbus AS350B3, operated by Precision, was on a post‑maintenance check flight with a 38‑year‑old senior pilot.

The National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) is leading the investigation and expects to issue a preliminary report within about 30 days. McMinnville Municipal Airport lacks a control tower; pilots use a shared radio frequency to announce positions.
Witnesses reported the helicopters were about 500 feet above ground when they collided, according to NTSB Air Safety Investigator Grant Mills during an October 30 briefing.
